sentences: During the spring term, I helped a youth music group prepare its instrument cases for a weekend trip.
The group had three large case, but none of the labels showed which instrument belonged inside.
The organiser asked me make a new list while the players finished their rehearsal.
I measured each case careful and copied its number onto a paper tag.
One player pointed out that I had wrote the same number on two tags.
I corrected the list, and the organiser thanked the volunteers stayed late to check the cases.
We were tired, but everyone looked forward to hear the group perform the next day.
Before closing the cupboard, we checked that each small drum were protected by a soft cloth and that no strap was missing.
The organiser gave us some useful advices, and we were very proudly of our careful work.
She also reminded us that we should to check the labels again when the cases came back.
